title: Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Purchase-Price Adjustment Schedule
content:
**Purchase-price adjustment — Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant**

A purchase-price adjustment applies to the grant award, read from the property value recorded on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File. The adjustment is added to the grant award with its sign, ahead of the lowering to the program's credit cap and the rounding to the cent.

| Property value on the loan file | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| above 225000.00 | adds 250.00 |
| 150000.00 or less | subtracts 250.00 |
| any other value (above 150000.00 and at most 225000.00) | adds nothing |

### Clause

A property value above 225000.00 adds 250.00, a property value of 150000.00 or less subtracts 250.00, and any other property value adds nothing.

### At the thresholds (hypothetical values)

| Property value | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| 150000.00 | subtracts 250.00 |
| 150000.01 | adds nothing |
| 225000.00 | adds nothing |
| 225000.01 | adds 250.00 |

The value read is the property value on the file, not the base loan amount.
